# ToolPond

> ToolPond provides free online calculators, converters, productivity tools and browser games, created and maintained by Shahid Abbas. Tools run in the browser, so entered values are not sent to a server. Results are estimates for general information and are not medical, financial or legal advice.

Method and sources for each tool are described at https://toolpond.org/methodology.html. Errors can be reported at https://toolpond.org/contact.html.

## Calculators and tools

- [Free Age Calculator: Exact Age in Years, Months & Days](https://toolpond.org/age-calculator.html): Free age calculator - Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, and total days lived. Find days until next birthday. No signup needed.
- [Content Idea Generator — Blog Titles & Social Media Hooks](https://toolpond.org/ai-writing-assistant.html): Generate content ideas instantly. Enter a topic and get ready-made titles, blog angles, and social media hooks. Free, no signup, works in your browser.
- [Auto Loan Calculator: Monthly Car Payment Estimator](https://toolpond.org/auto-loan-calculator.html): Free auto loan calculator. Enter price, down payment, rate, term, tax and fees to see your monthly car payment, total interest and a full amortization schedule.
- [Remove Solid Background from Image: Transparent PNG](https://toolpond.org/background-remover.html): Free tool to remove a white or solid-colour background from an image and download a transparent PNG. Runs in your browser; your image is not uploaded by the tool.
- [Free BMI Calculator - Body Mass Index for Adults](https://toolpond.org/bmi-calculator.html): Free BMI calculator for adults. Enter your height and weight in kg/cm or lbs/inches to get your BMI, weight category and healthy weight range instantly.
- [Free Body Fat Calculator - Navy Method & BMI Method](https://toolpond.org/body-fat-calculator.html): Free body fat calculator using the U.S. Navy method and BMI method. Get your body fat percentage, lean mass, fat mass and ideal body fat for your age in US.
- [50/30/20 Budget Calculator: Monthly Budget Planner](https://toolpond.org/budget-planner.html): Free 50/30/20 budget calculator. Enter your take-home pay and expenses to see needs, wants and savings against the rule, with examples from $2,000 to $8,000.
- [Calorie Calculator: TDEE, BMR & Calorie Deficit (2026)](https://toolpond.org/calorie-calculator.html): Free calorie calculator: find your TDEE, BMR and calories to lose or gain weight. Set a goal weight and date, compare 3 formulas, and get macros.
- [Color Palette Generator — HEX, RGB & HSL Values](https://toolpond.org/color-palette-generator.html): Free color palette generator with HEX, RGB and HSL values. Make monochromatic, complementary, analogous or triadic palettes and copy colors in one click.
- [Compound Interest Calculator - Investment Growth Projector](https://toolpond.org/compound-interest-calculator.html): Compound Interest Calculator - Project investment growth with year-by-year breakdowns. Learn the Rule of 72, compound vs simple interest, and investing.
- [Content Calendar — Plan & Schedule Posts](https://toolpond.org/content-calendar-generator.html): Plan and schedule social media posts and blog content. Track status, organize by platform, and export your calendar as CSV.
- [Free Image Converter 2026 | PNG to JPG, WebP & PDF Online](https://toolpond.org/converter-png.html): Free online image converter. Convert PNG to JPG, JPG to PNG, WebP, and PDF instantly. Compress images, adjust quality, and shrink file size.
- [Unit Converter: Length, Weight, Temperature, Volume](https://toolpond.org/converter.html): Free unit converter for length, weight, temperature, volume, speed and area. Instant results, formulas, charts and cooking conversions, right in your browser.
- [Credit Card Payoff Calculator: Avalanche vs Snowball](https://toolpond.org/credit-card.html): Free credit card payoff calculator. Compare avalanche and snowball plans, see your debt-free date and total interest, with worked examples and a monthly schedule.
- [Currency Converter: Live Exchange Rates, 40 Currencies](https://toolpond.org/currency-converter.html): Free currency converter with daily exchange rates for 40 currencies. Convert USD, EUR, GBP, PKR, INR and more, and add a bank fee to see what you receive.
- [Free GPA Calculator - Calculate Weighted & Unweighted GPA](https://toolpond.org/gpa-calculator.html): Free GPA calculator - Calculate your Grade Point Average instantly with weighted grades and credits. Supports 4.0, 5.0, and percentage scales.
- [Hashtag Generator — Tags for Instagram, TikTok & Twitter](https://toolpond.org/hashtag-generator.html): Generate hashtags for Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter. Enter a topic to get platform-specific tags. Free, no signup, works in your browser.

## About and policies

- [About ToolPond | Free Calculators, Tools and Games](https://toolpond.org/about.html): ToolPond offers free online calculators, converters, tools and games, created by Shahid Abbas in Pakistan. Learn how it is built.
- [Contact ToolPond | Corrections, Feedback and Questions](https://toolpond.org/contact.html): Contact ToolPond to report a calculator error, suggest a tool or ask a question. Email Shahid Abbas, who replies within two business days.
- [Disclaimer: Health, Finance and General](https://toolpond.org/disclaimer.html): Important limits of ToolPond calculators: results are estimates, not medical, financial, legal or tax advice.
- [How ToolPond Tools Are Built and Reviewed](https://toolpond.org/methodology.html): How ToolPond builds, checks and updates its calculators and guides, the formulas they use, and how to report an error.
- [Privacy Policy](https://toolpond.org/privacy-policy.html): How ToolPond handles your data: calculations stay in your browser, and Google may use cookies for advertising and fonts.
- [Terms of Use](https://toolpond.org/terms.html): The terms that apply when you use ToolPond calculators, converters, games and guides at toolpond.org.
